property.name: deployment_mode
property.description: Use the compatibility single-node server or the distributed storage, insert, and select components.

property.name: retention_period
property.description: Data retention period accepted by VictoriaMetrics, for example 12 for months or 30d for days.

property.name: replication_factor
property.description: Number of copies written to distinct VMSTORAGE nodes in distributed mode.

property.name: dedup_min_scrape_interval
property.description: Deduplication interval for storage replication. Replicated VMAGENT scrapes instead use the managed scrape interval.

property.name: tenant_id
property.description: VictoriaMetrics cluster tenant in accountID or accountID:projectID form.

property.name: vmstorage_http_port
property.description: HTTP listen port for health, status, and metrics endpoints.

property.name: vmstorage_vminsert_port
property.description: TCP port used by VMINSERT to send data to VMSTORAGE.

property.name: vmstorage_vmselect_port
property.description: TCP port used by VMSELECT to read data from VMSTORAGE.

property.name: vmstorage_data_dir
property.description: Persistent data path local to each VMSTORAGE host.

property.name: vminsert_http_port
property.description: HTTP listen port for distributed ingestion.

property.name: vmselect_http_port
property.description: HTTP listen port for distributed queries.

property.name: vmselect_cache_dir
property.description: Persistent cache path local to each VMSELECT host.
